title: Snake
summary: Online multiplayer Snake game with real-time rendering and SQL-backed scoreboard

data.text: An online multiplayer Snake game developed for CS 3500 using C# and Blazor. We built a real-time client visualization engine that renders game state from JSON and supports 8+ concurrent players. The game also includes a real-time SQL-backed scoreboard that displays live player statistics, updated dynamically using server-sent events.
